title: ProCARE: Real-World Study Automation via Profile-Grounded Evidence Contracts
abstract: arXiv:2610.16175v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Real-world studies (RWS) analyze routinely collected healthcare data, such as electronic health records and insurance claims, to estimate treatment effects, monitor safety, and identify risk factors outside randomized trials. Automating RWS with large language model agents is appealing but brittle: valid analyses depend on dataset-specific clinical semantics, including index dates, follow-up windows, patient/event-level units, and outcome boundaries that are often implicit in observational data. This leads to schema mismatches, temporal errors, inconsistent analytical granularity, and unsupported clinical claims. We present ProCARE, a profile-grounded framework that reformulates RWS automation as constrained compilation. translated_title: ProCARE：基于画像锚定证据合同的真实世界研究自动化
translated_abstract: 真实世界研究（RWS）通过分析常规收集的医疗数据（如电子健康记录和保险理赔数据），来估计治疗效果、监测安全性，并在随机试验之外识别风险因素。利用大语言模型智能体自动化RWS虽然很有吸引力，但十分脆弱：有效的分析依赖于数据集特定的临床语义，包括指标日期、随访窗口、患者/事件级别的分析单元，以及在观察性数据中往往是隐含的结果边界。这会导致模式不匹配、时间错误、分析粒度不一致以及缺乏依据的临床结论。我们提出了ProCARE，一个以数据画像为基础的框架，它将RWS自动化重新表述为受约束的编译问题。ProCARE将异构的数据画像转换为“证据合同”，其中规定了可用变量、时间属性、分布和证据限制，并将研究目标编译为强类型的RWS-IR……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: ProCARE将真实世界研究自动化重新表述为受约束的编译问题，通过把异构数据画像转化为规定可用变量、时间属性和证据限制的“证据合同”，解决了大语言模型智能体因临床语义隐含而导致的分析脆弱性问题。
en_tdlr: ProCARE reformulates real-world study automation as constrained compilation, converting heterogeneous data profiles into Evidence Contracts that specify available variables, temporal attributes, and evidentiary limits, thereby addressing the brittleness of LLM-agent automation caused by implicit dataset-specific clinical semantics.
